successCriteria.note: First-person Dark Mechanicus card. Every claim is cited to a DarkMechanicus v0.8.0 README/docs file:line, and the orchestrator spot-checked them. It links to the repo and /releases/latest. Live at both widths.

Two real desktop-app screenshots (plan graph, ticket editor) with descriptive alt text. The worker and the orchestrator each checked them for private repo names, paths, usernames and ids. The person approved them.

DarkMechanicusPlanView renders the sprints with their goals, every ticket's key, title and text status, every edge, and an accessible text list. Live: all six tickets sit inside the card at 1280, and the columns stack at 375.

scripts/export-dm-plan.mjs reads the committed records at dev/build time through a Vite plugin, with no Dark Mechanicus install and output built from an allowlist. Unit tests cover a poisoned fixture, byte-identical output and loud failures. /darkmechanicus/plan.json returns 200 live.
The Fantasy World Generator showcase and the other cards still render (unit + e2e). The full gate was green in DGI-5 and in PR #12 CI.

PR #12 merged with every check green and a red-team review posted (no Blocking findings). Pages deploy run 41565747679 succeeded, including the smoke check. Verified live at 1280 and 375 with no page-level horizontal scroll.

outcome.summary: All six epic success criteria are met. The showcase is live on https://davgor.github.io/coding-reference from merge 617f4d5.

title: Showcase Dark Mechanicus on Coding Reference
